description: The only window. Core window features plus Berth Studio's own commands; no shell, no file system, no HTTP. The updater and dialog plugins' own commands are not allowed: updates go through check_update and install_update, and exports through save_export, which opens the Save dialog from Rust and writes only the path it returns. start-dragging is not in core:default and the title bar is an overlay, so without it the window cannot be moved.
